parameters.name: DownloadToFile
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to download the log file. Valid values:
- false (default): Does not download the log file.
- true: Downloads the log file.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. Default value: current time.

parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description: The job ID. To obtain the job ID, see [ListJobs](~~459676~~).

parameters.name: MaxLines
parameters.description: The maximum number of log lines returned. Default value: 2000.

parameters.name: PodId
parameters.description: The node ID. To obtain the node ID, see [GetJob](~~459677~~).

parameters.name: PodUid
parameters.description: The node UID. To obtain the node UID, see [GetJob](~~459677~~).

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. Default value: 7 days ago.
